body.x: JD Sound(CEO Kim Hee-chan, www.jdsound.co.kr), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, unveiled portable DJing devices 'PDJ' at '2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after 'CES 2013') held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11
As applying two touch-pad LCDs first time and using multiple buttons, 'PDJ' adds analog sensibility and maximizes ease of manipulation.

In addition, it got 10 patents and won the Award of Small and Medium Business Administration in February 2012. In June 2012, it awarded a gold medal at Pittsburgh International Exhibition of Invention and due to innovative and novel design, it was selected as Good-design in September 2012 and has been recognized for the excellence of the product.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project 'New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
